about: The launcher the signed manifest names (manifest.json launcher: version and assets). Since 1.5.0 it is Encore, built and published by Encore's own release (repo and tag below); release.yml downloads each file, fh2mp-release manifest-build checks it against the SHA-256 and size here and the release carries it, because a 1.4.x FH2MP Launcher downloads its update from the manifest's own tag. Assets are keyed by the 1.4.x launcher's flavours (launcher/fh2mp_launcher/updater.py launcher_flavour at v1.4.8): windows-x64-installer is run with /SILENT /SUPPRESSMSGBOXES /CLOSEAPPLICATIONS /RESTARTAPPLICATIONS; windows-x64-portable is a zip with fh2mp-launcher.exe at its root, copied over the portable folder and started; linux-appimage is copied over $APPIMAGE; linux-deb is installed with apt-get. A flavour left out sends that launcher to the release page. minLauncher is the manifest's minLauncher. Every sha256 and size must be filled in from Encore's published files before a release can be built.
